compiled_state.title: Per-branch CI review + branch protection: unified sub-branch-to-session PR architecture for sprint and debug-everything in ci-pr mode
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context

DSO's ci-pr workflow mode currently has incoherent LLM review semantics for operators running /dso:sprint and /dso:debug-everything. Sprint Phase A (session-init, creates a long-lived session→main draft PR) opens the session PR correctly, but Phase F (per-story commit + merge) opens story PRs with base=main and auto-merges each one to main directly — orphaning the session draft PR and triggering full-PR llm-review re-reviews of code already cleared by per-story review on every story push. In a representative 5-story sprint, this produces ~3 redundant whole-PR re-reviews on already-approved hunks. /dso:debug-everything Phase F/G (per-tier and per-bug-batch sub-branches) reviews them via local /dso:review sub-agent dispatch, diverging from sprint's CI-driven flow.

This epic refactors both skills onto a unified architecture: when dso.workflow=ci-pr, all sub-branches (story/**, fix/**, bug-batch/**) open PRs against the session branch, gated by a Per-Branch LLM Review CI workflow under GitHub Rulesets (preferred over classic branch protection for session-* pattern scoping per Research Findings). A single session→main PR is the lone path to main; its required check is provenance verification (3-signal cross-check, pinned check-name) plus a narrow integration LLM review whose scope is un-provenanced commits ∪ files modified in ≥2 sub-branches.

Phase definitions: Sprint Phase A = session-init (create-sprint-draft-pr.sh); Sprint Phase F = post-story merge step (changes PR base to session); Debug Phase F = tier 0-1 auto-fix sub-branches; Debug Phase G = tier 2-7 fix-batch sub-branches.

Depends on 3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796 (dso.workflow config consolidation). Supersedes 8ee4-c51c-c546-4d4e (cycle-tracking) and cafb-4b97-1703-41e3 (squash SHA-rewrite class). Coordinates with b575-ac1c-f720-4839 (cycle-end arbiter — both edit ci.yml llm-review) and 0cf2-42b5-8840-48a1 (sprint SKILL.md refactor — both edit Phase F) via named-step contracts. Reverse depends_on: af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81 (HARD-GATE enforcement) will be blocked by this epic.

## Success Criteria

1. Provenance integrity: every commit in main..session-HEAD on the session→main PR traces to a sub-branch PR whose Per-Branch LLM Review (matching pinned dso.review.check_name) returned SUCCESS, or is reported with its SHA and routed into the integration review's scope. Verified by a fixture sprint where (a) all commits are provenanced (verifier exits 0) and (b) a synthetic direct-to-session commit is injected (verifier exits non-zero, reports the SHA, and the injected commit appears in the integration scope's input file).

2. No re-review of per-branch-approved code: integration LLM review input contains zero hunks for files confined to a single sub-branch with passing review. Verified by inspecting the integration review's input on a fixture sprint where 3 stories touch disjoint files — the input contains zero matching paths for those files.

3. Cross-story integration coverage: integration review scope includes files modified by >=2 sub-branches in the current session. Verified by a fixture sprint where Story A and Story B both modify lib/helper.py — the integration review's input contains the cumulative diff for lib/helper.py.

4. Workflow + branch protection enforced end-to-end: sub-branch PRs base on session-branch; per-branch-review.yml fires for story/fix/bug-batch pushes; Rulesets on session-* reject direct pushes; Phase A preflight asserts (a) Ruleset exists and matches session-*, (b) pinned check name appears in required_status_checks.checks, (c) required_linear_history is false. Verified empirically: a representative sprint produces sub-branch PRs with the expected base; gh run list --workflow=per-branch-review.yml returns >=1 run per branch pattern; an attempted direct push to session is rejected with the expected branch-protection error; the preflight exits non-zero on missing or misconfigured Ruleset.

5. Skill convergence in ci-pr; local mode preserved byte-identical: sprint Phase F + debug Phase F/G in ci-pr mode both invoke per-branch-review.yml; their SKILL.md files reference no local /dso:review in ci-pr branches. Local mode byte-identical to a pre-epic baseline (commit-breadcrumbs.log + git log --pretty=format output diff). Deprecated path sprint-story-review.yml is renamed to per-branch-review.yml; all named consumer files updated: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md, tests/workflows/test-sprint-story-review.sh (renamed), tests/workflows/test-sprint-story-review-defenses.sh (renamed), tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh, tests/scripts/test-ci-defense-pipeline.sh, tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py, and docs/findings/sprint-resume-state.md. Verified by grep -rn 'sprint-story-review' returning zero matches outside explicit deprecation notes.

6. Superseded bugs closed with reproducers passing: bug 8ee4-c51c-c546-4d4e closed with DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE>=2 computed correctly on the session→main PR and prior defenses in TrackerDefenseStore suppressed in the integration review (reproducer: write a defense via defense_store_write, push a triggering commit, observe the cycle-2 review skipping the defended finding). Bug cafb-4b97-1703-41e3 closed with the new API-based provenance check accepting a squash-merged sub-branch's commits as provenanced (reproducer: create a sub-branch PR, squash-merge it into session, run the provenance verifier on a session→main PR including that squash commit — verifier exits 0).

## Operational Constraints

- Provenance retry/backoff: provenance verifier uses exponential backoff (initial 2s, doubled per retry, cap 60s) on gh api commits/<sha>/pulls returning 403/429. Per-walk budget ceiling of 200 API calls; on exhaustion, exit non-zero with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED marker. Per-session SHA→PR-number cache stored in artifact to avoid re-querying on re-runs.
- Ruleset provisioning ownership: one-time repo-admin setup of the session-* Ruleset is the documented prerequisite (instructions added to INSTALL.md and to /dso:onboarding for new projects). Phase A preflight (see SC4) detects missing or misconfigured Ruleset and fails fast with an actionable error message linking to setup docs. This epic does NOT mandate that DSO hold administration:write permission at runtime — operators retain control of branch protection administration.
- In-flight migration: when this epic ships, in-flight sprint sessions may have open story PRs targeting main. A one-time migration script (migrate-story-pr-bases.sh) detects these via gh pr list --search 'base:main head:story/', PATCHes their base to the session branch, then issues gh workflow run per-branch-review.yml --ref <head-branch> to re-trigger the required check. Run by operator before first new sprint after this epic merges.
- Exempt direct-push call sites (descoped from SC4's branch-protection rejection): plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/github-bootstrap.sh:114 (git push origin HEAD:main) is a one-time repo-bootstrap operation that occurs before any session branch exists; Rulesets on session-* do not apply. Tests that push directly to main (test-record-review.sh, test-merge-to-main-portability.sh, test-merge-state.sh, test-merge-to-main-cleanliness.sh, test-claude-safe-post-merge-amend.sh) are test-infrastructure operations against ephemeral fixtures, exempt.

## Scenario Analysis

- Concurrent sub-branch merges race condition (high, runtime): snapshot session-HEAD SHA at job start.
- GitHub API rate limiting (high, runtime): exponential backoff + 200-call budget + SHA→PR cache.
- Custom merge-commit template omits PR number (high, runtime): signals 1+2 (API + check status) are the trusted pair; signal 3 corroborating only.
- In-flight PRs target main at deploy time (high, deployment): one-time migration script.
- Branch protection requires admin pre-setup (high, deployment): documented one-time setup + Phase A preflight.
- Workflow rename breaks required-check reference (high, deployment): pinned dso.review.check_name config.
- SESSION_BRANCH resolution failure (critical, configuration): 3-step fallback (draft PR headRefName → vars.SPRINT_SESSION_ID → fail-fast, never silent default to main).
- dso.workflow=ci-pr unset silent local-mode fallback (medium, configuration): orchestrator warns when .sprint-active or .debug-active is set but dso.workflow != ci-pr.
- Empty integration scope (medium, configuration): job exits 0 cleanly.
- Direct-push commits unmapped by GitHub API (high, assumption): fail-closed; un-provenanced commits route into integration review.
- Squash on session→main collapses history (medium, assumption): documented choice in INSTALL.md; default merge-commit.
- Check-name drift between workflow and Ruleset (high, assumption): pinned config + Phase A preflight.

## Research Findings

### External Integration: GitHub Branch Protection / Rulesets API
- Trigger condition name: External integration
- Query summary: programmatic branch protection configuration, required permissions, merge-style interactions, modern Rulesets alternative
- Source URLs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/branches/branch-protection, https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/managing-rulesets/available-rules-for-rulesets, https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules
- Key insight: Classic protection (PUT /branches/{branch}/protection) and Rulesets (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets) both require admin permissions. required_linear_history=true BLOCKS merge commits — must be false on session-* so merge-commit PR-number references survive. Rulesets (2023+) are the recommended path for dynamic per-sprint branches due to pattern-based scoping (e.g., session-*) and per-session toggleability.

### Migration: Sub-Branch PR Base Re-Targeting
- Trigger condition name: Migration / compatibility
- Query summary: PATCH API for changing open PR base, CI re-trigger semantics, working migration examples
- Source URLs: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/pulls, https://github.com/heroku/main-branch-switch/blob/main/retarget.sh, https://github.com/ethomson/retarget_prs
- Key insight: PATCH /pulls/{n} with a base field retargets cleanly; GitHub recomputes the diff but CI workflows are NOT auto-re-triggered. The migration script must explicitly issue gh workflow run (or workflow_dispatch) after PATCHing the base to re-trigger required checks. Working examples exist; not a capability gap.

## Cross-Epic Interactions

- Resource: .github/workflows/ci.yml (llm-review job + general CI workflow)
  Overlapping epics: b575-ac1c-f720-4839, c337-ed61, curly-mount-page, cf7b-86a9, flaw-beach-spice, clay-ditty-meld, 6add-c1fc, 0253-1cee-aa0d-4002, jira-dig-2366, cbea-3722, jira-dig-2371.
  Interaction: This epic rewires the llm-review job (provenance verifier + narrow integration LLM review scope). The named epics modify the same job from different angles (arbiter step, provider abstraction, telemetry, quality gates, external-reviewer integration).
  Gate: This epic exposes stable named steps (provenance, integration-review) in the llm-review job so other epics' additions compose cleanly; this epic does not assume exclusive ownership of the job.

- Resource: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md Phase F
  Overlapping epics: 0cf2-42b5-8840-48a1, dso-fbky, jira-dig-2349, 70f6-05f1.
  Interaction: This epic changes Phase F merge target (session vs main), merge-style enforcement, and trailer/branch-protection signal handling. Named epics modify Phase F's structure (refactor), execution-mode semantics (autonomous override), or its PR-handling tail.
  Gate: This epic's Phase F edits MUST rebase cleanly on top of any refactor that landed earlier; later epic resolves merge conflicts via rebase.

- Resource: plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md Phase F/G
  Overlapping epics: 0cf2-42b5-8840-48a1, dso-fbky, jira-dig-2349.
  Interaction: This epic converges debug-everything's ci-pr branch onto the same per-branch CI gate as sprint. Same coordination constraints from sprint Phase F apply.
  Gate: Same as sprint Phase F gate, scoped to debug-everything.

- Resource: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (provenance + commit metadata)
  Overlapping epics: jira-dig-2380.
  Interaction: This epic adds PR-number cross-checks as one of three provenance signals on merge commits. jira-dig-2380 writes structured source-attribution metadata on commits.
  Gate: Merge commit format MUST accommodate both PR-number provenance reference and source-attribution metadata as orthogonal fields without colliding.

- Resource: code review findings.json pipeline (consumed by replay regression harnesses)
  Overlapping epics: astir-sill-twirl, balk-ozone-dip.
  Interaction: This epic emits narrow integration LLM review findings on the session→main PR. The replay regression harnesses consume findings.json artifacts for drift detection.
  Gate: Integration review writes output to the existing findings.json schema such that consumers do not require schema changes.

- Resource: dso:code-reviewer-* agent registry / dispatch
  Overlapping epics: dso-8l5h.
  Interaction: This epic's Per-Branch LLM Review uses the existing review-runner dispatch which consumes the dso:code-reviewer-* registry. dso-8l5h reshapes that registry.
  Gate: Per-branch review dispatch MUST consume whatever shape the registry has at the time it lands; later epic adopts earlier epic's shape.

## Dependencies

### Planning Intelligence Log

- **Web research (Step 2.6)**: triggered
  - Bright-line conditions that fired: External integration (GitHub Branch Protection / Rulesets API), Migration / compatibility (PATCH /pulls base re-targeting)
- **Scenario analysis (Step 2.75)**: triggered
  - Scenarios surviving blue team filter: 12 (out of 14 red team scenarios; 2 filtered — gh pr merge --auto race [not applicable given --merge orchestration], 3b8b dependency restatement [already in scope])
- **Practitioner-requested additional cycles**: none
- **Follow-on scrutiny (Step 0)**: not triggered
- **Feasibility resolution (Step 2.5)**: not triggered (feasibility integration_risk=3 ≥ 3 threshold; no FEASIBILITY_GAP section needed; integration risks addressed inline via Operational Constraints additions to v2 spec rather than via FEASIBILITY_GAP loop)
- **LLM-instruction signal (Step 5)**: not triggered
- **Scale context (Step 0)**: not applicable (no volume decision — this is a CI/architecture refactor, not a throughput/data-store/concurrency feature)

#### Cross-Epic Scan Summary

- Candidate epics scanned: 186 (10 batches × 19, last batch 15)
- Batch dispatch quality: 5 batches returned clean structured JSON; 5 batches degraded (summary-only, content confusion) due to sub-agent context-window auto-compaction — captured as bug 4bf1-3198-0fe1-4e1a (P1) for batch-size reduction to 5.
- Signal severity distribution:
  - benign: ~25 (logged only)
  - consideration: ~20 (consolidated into 6 Cross-Epic Interactions entries via Step 2.26 dedupe-by-shared-resource)
  - ambiguity: 1 real (af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81 Phase F overlap), 1 hallucinated (jira-dig-2316, not in local tracker)
  - conflict: 1 (fb32-215c-4c78-4e36 — resolved structurally by 3b8b dependency chain; 3b8b's description plans to close fb32 at landing)
- Step 2.27 halt/resolution: practitioner selected option (b) Override with the constraint that af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81 must be linked depends_on this epic (reverse dependency); link created in Phase 3 Step 2.

#### Fidelity Review Outcomes (pre-revision)

- Agent Clarity: self_contained=3 (major: Phase A/F/G undefined inline), success_measurable=5
- Scope: right_sized=4, no_overlap=3 (major: b575-ac1c coordination unaddressed), dependency_aware=4, consumer_completeness=3 (major: test_dispatch_schema_correction.py uncovered; bootstrap.sh not descoped)
- Value: user_impact=4, validation_signal=5 (passed clean)
- Feasibility: technical_feasibility=4, integration_risk=3 (major: rate-limit retry/backoff strategy unspecified; Ruleset provisioning ownership unspecified)

#### v2 Spec Revisions (in response to fidelity findings)

- Added inline Phase A/F/G definitions and parenthetical summaries for cross-referenced ticket IDs (Agent Clarity)
- Added coordinates_with b575-ac1c with named-step contract for ci.yml llm-review job (Scope no_overlap)
- Extended SC5 with explicit consumer file list + grep verification; added Operational Constraints descope for github-bootstrap.sh and test-infra direct-push call sites (Scope consumer_completeness)
- Added Operational Constraints: exponential-backoff retry/200-call budget/SHA→PR cache for provenance; one-time admin Ruleset setup + Phase A preflight check (Feasibility integration_risk)
- Quantified operator pain in Context ("~3 redundant whole-PR re-reviews per 5-story sprint") (Value minor)

No structural change (SC count unchanged at 6, scope unchanged); structural-change re-review HARD-GATE not triggered. Practitioner approved revised spec at the approval gate without requesting re-dispatch of fidelity reviewers.
